chunks: Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babawayh al-Qummi (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. al-Hasan b. Aban narrated to us from al-Husayn b. Sa'id from al-Husayn b. Ulwan from Amr b. Shimr from Jabir from Abu Ja'far al-Baqir (peace be upon him). He said:

The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family) would, when he saw the crescent moon of Ramadan, face the qibla and say: O Allah! Let the crescent appear upon us with security, faith, peace, Islam, magnificent wellness, encompassing sustenance, warding of illnesses, recitation of the Quran, and assistance for prayer and fasting. O Allah! Deliver us to the month of Ramadan, deliver it to us, and accept it from us; until the month of Ramadan ends and You have forgiven us. Then he would face the people and say: O assembly of Muslims! When the crescent moon of Ramadan appears, the rebellious devils are chained, the gates of heaven, Paradise, and mercy are opened, and the gates of the Fire are closed. Prayers are answered, and at every breaking of fast, Allah frees captives from the Fire. Every night a caller calls: 'Is there anyone who asks? Is there anyone who seeks forgiveness? O Allah! Give every spender a replacement, and give every withholder a loss.' Until the crescent of Shawwal appears, and the believers are called to go forth to their rewards, for it is the Day of Reward.
Then Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, by the One in whose Hand is my soul! It is not a reward of gold and silver coins.

key_terms.غُلَّتْ مَرَدَةُ الشَّيَاطِينِ: the rebellious devils are chained, describing the spiritual conditions of Ramadan
key_terms.هِلَالِ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the crescent moon of Ramadan, marking the beginning of the fasting month
key_terms.يَوْمُ الْجَائِزَةِ: the Day of Reward, referring to Eid al-Fitr as the day believers receive their divine reward

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say when he saw the crescent moon of Ramadan?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) narrates that when the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) saw the crescent moon of Ramadan, he would face the qibla and make a comprehensive supplication asking for security, faith, wellness, sustenance, and assistance for worship. He would then address the people, describing the spiritual transformation that occurs during Ramadan: devils are chained, gates of heaven and mercy are opened, gates of hell are closed, prayers are accepted, and captives are freed from the Fire nightly. The Imam adds that the reward promised on Eid is not material wealth but something far greater.
